memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Diabetes mellitus type 2
  - Status: HbA1c 8.2% (last 3 months), fasting glucose 156 mg/dL, weight 68 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cut‑off for men).
  - Plan: Continue metformin 500 mg BD after food, add glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast. Review diet: small frequent meals, reduce refined carbs.
- Hypothyroidism
  - Status: TSH 4.8 mIU/L (slightly elevated), on levothyroxine 50 mcg OD.
  - Plan: Increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD, repeat TSH in 6‑8 weeks.
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Episodes triggered by lying to right side, Dix‑Hallpike positive right posterior canal.
  - Plan: Start betahistine 16 mg BD after food; meclizine 25 mg SOS after food for acute vertigo. Vestibular rehab advice.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: LDL 130 mg/dL, HDL 38 mg/dL, triglycerides 210 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Atorvastatin 10 mg OD at night, repeat lipid profile in 3 months.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Diabetes mellitus type 2
  - Status: HbA1c 7.6% (down from 8.2%), fasting glucose 138 mg/dL, weight 67 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off).
  - Plan: Continue metformin, reduce glimepiride to 0.5 mg OD before breakfast. Reinforce carbohydrate counting.
- Hypothyroidism
  - Status: TSH 2.9 mIU/L (target), on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD.
  - Plan: Keep dose, repeat TSH in 6 months.
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Two brief episodes in past month, meclizine used PRN.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD; meclizine 25 mg SOS only if needed. Brandt‑Daroff exercises twice daily.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: LDL 115 mg/dL, HDL 40 mg/dL, triglycerides 180 mg/dL on atorvastatin 10 mg.
  - Plan: Increase atorvastatin to 20 mg OD at night.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-10-10.

memories.text: Resting ECG: Normal sinus rhythm, rate 72 bpm. No ST‑T changes, no Q waves. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to ENT Vertigo Clinic, St. Martha’s Hospital, for positional vertigo refractory to medical management. Request Dix‑Hallpike under supervision and consider canalith repositioning.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: ENT report: Dix‑Hallpike confirmed right posterior canal BPPV. Performed Epley maneuver; patient symptom‑free post‑procedure. Advised to avoid rapid head movements for 48 h. No further intervention needed; follow‑up in 4 weeks if recurrence.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling light‑headed when I get up quickly from my chair, especially in the mornings. The spinning sensation lasts a few seconds and then passes. I’ve taken meclizine a couple of times this week and it helps. My blood sugar checks at home have been around 130‑150 mg/dL fasting.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Diabetes mellitus type 2
  - Status: HbA1c 7.2% (improved), fasting glucose 128 mg/dL, weight 66 kg, waist 88 cm (<90 cm cut‑off).
  - Plan: Maintain current metformin and glimepiride doses. Continue dietary moderation.
- Hypothyroidism
  - Status: TSH 2.2 mIU/L, levothyroxine 75 mcg OD adequate.
  - Plan: Repeat TSH in 12 months.
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: No vertigo episodes in past 3 months; meclizine not used.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD; consider tapering if asymptomatic for another month.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: LDL 100 mg/dL, HDL 42 mg/dL, triglycerides 150 mg/dL on atorvastatin 20 mg.
  - Plan: Statin dose adequate; repeat lipid profile in 12 months.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2027-01-05 (outside window, but noted).
